matches.rationale: Pred1 and Pred3 both target the same Theorem 1.1 proof step: extending a non-trivial automorphism of span{x_i} by fixing y in Y, and both identify the required span(Y) ∩ span{x_i} = {0} condition that the paper only partially justifies. Pred2 concerns a separate Theorem 3.1 counterexample, so it does not detect this ground-truth defect.

pred_verdicts.rationale: It identifies the invalid automorphism extension in Theorem 1.1 by showing the fixed set Y and span{x_i} need trivial intersection.
It raises a separate concrete counterexample to Theorem 3.1/abstract that is not the ground-truth Theorem 1.1 defect.
It describes the same Theorem 1.1 well-definedness conflict and corroborates pred1.
